items.text: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is BACK with its biggest update ever! We've given the game a major overhaul to fix the issues we had at launch, and it's finally ready to be the party game it was always meant to be.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/846bf03da7975bf8998299e57aca0bb46fc97b81.png"]
Smoother first-time experience: new players are now nudged through the improved tutorial and into Practice Mode, so everyone feels ready when they hit the track
Practice while you wait: Practice Mode (formerly Training Grounds) is now available right from the lobby, so you can warm up while your friends go get a snack
New How to Play guide: an illustrated slideshow in character select that explains the game to anyone who's never played
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/b6f7a2c258491cb0fdaea665c33c032ffcad6e41.gif"]
New character: Bunny is back on a hand-powered tricycle, with outfits to unlock
Two new levels: Quarry, with giant drills triggered by passing players, and Spook House, a spooky roller coaster with ghost trains and some of the best music in the game
Redesigned Pasture with a brand new layout
Four new blocks: Treadmill, Bonus Ring, Spring Zone, and Bubble
A huge audio pass with new sound effects across levels, blocks, menus, and the scoreboard
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/52abb5a04cc82af2f944580a9f13415127444223.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/c2a251512bfb19b1039f01aa07c978fc651ce974.gif"]
Comeback points, reworked: simpler, more impactful, and you can now earn them by finishing a race in last place, so a rough round can still turn into a good one
Better PC controller support: PS5, Switch Pro (wireless), and off-brand controllers now work without enabling Steam Input, and Xbox controllers no longer cause double cursors when it's on
The level flyby is back, so you can scope out the level before it gets chaotic
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/90b2bad39dd31db444c9021c16288355aa952854.gif"]
Optimized level art, a clearer scoreboard, an overhauled unlocks screen, better block placement prompts, and tons of bug fixes. Check out the blog post for all the details.

As always, tell us what you think on the Clever Endeavour Discord. We're super proud of the massive overhaul USR has received, and we feel it's ready to shine. Help us make it shine by sharing it with your friends!!
See you on the track 🏁🐑🦝

items.text: a ton of bug fixes
character control changes
party mode / power-up changes
new levels
new blocks
a completely rebuilt camera system
…and much much more.
This update includes improvements we’ve been wanting to make since launch, and also responds directly to player feedback and reviews. Hop into the game again today and check it out!

We know that the quality of Ultimate Sheep Raccoon did not live up to the expectations our fans had after playing our first game, Ultimate Chicken Horse. We’re committed to delivering on those expectations, and we’re doing so through updates like these and through open communication with our community (you!).
You can read more about this commitment on our blog post, and see the USR Future Work Page to find out what we’re prioritizing next.

notes.title: Here’s a preview of the new stuff you can find in-game today

items.text: The Pillow Block
Bounce your way to victory with the new springy pillow block! It can be used to spring upwards, get a boost forwards, or create dangerous situations for your fellow animal cyclists.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/3d5981aec3d8fc24725f3ffaa78726919b6ebf9b.gif"]
The Zapper Block
It’s not only mosquitos that get zapped here—don’t stay in the zapper’s range for too long or you’ll get got!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/f7719bb9ee151bc4b9bcf6616ca7237b48e63bb4.gif"]
Castle Level
Ride swiftly on thine steel stallion, fearsome beast! Careful though, the castle shifts every round!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/8c6cc349d55b666909d6ce64a01eecd1c300cf8e.gif"]
Waterfall Redux Level
One of the classic levels from Ultimate Chicken Horse gets a remake, with more sunset and an equally amazing song
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/2e45133687ba6c79ac85fc3492718280ebd75589.png"]
We’d love to know what you think about the changes to the game, after playing it again let us know what you think in the comments or in our Discord. More coming soon!

The latest update for Ultimate Sheep Raccoon comes directly from the top things the community has been requesting to improve the game, including blocks with more interactivity, control/physics improvements, additional scoring options, a revamped tutorial and a lot more. This isn’t the end though, we’ve already started work on the next update!
[p align="start"]⚠️⚠️ Nintendo Players ⚠️⚠️
THIS UPDATE GOT STUCK IN CERTIFICATION ON SWITCH / SWITCH 2 AND WILL BE RELEASED ASAP. FOR NOW, CROSS-PLAY BETWEEN NITNENDO AND OTHER PLATFORMS WILL NOT WORK.
You probably don’t want to be behind this one…
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/65f8bfa3-18d3-4c65-a67c-41f86da7ba2c/2026-02-19+Skunk.gif"]
💣 Sea Mine — Bounce on the balloons to drop the mine which will bounce and roll around the level before exploding.

🔄 Rotating Terrain Block — It’s like terrain, but… it spins. This can be used to slow others down, or as a ramp to jump up to places you couldn’t reach otherwise, or as a platform to make a tough level easier.
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/c4987f4e-2df7-45f8-b87c-47347c0e0721/RotatingTerrain.gif"]
⛓️ Chain Hazard — Goes back and forth and knocks you off your bike (or knocks you out in Hardcore Mode)
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/f60a214a-a6d4-4c88-8995-cf5c487a8c59/2026-02-19+MovingHazard.gif"]
🛹 New Rail! — Another shape of rail, actually the original shaped rail and then somehow it got lost in the project… but it’s back!
We did a big pass on character movement to make racing feel more responsive and less janky:
No more wheels popping out sideways after turning around (check out this video on our Discord)
Made sure that a jump while falling or double jumping always gives upward lift
Fixed awkward landing animation cutoffs
Changed how coming down ramps and up ramps works slightly
Played with some physics values to make it feel better

🚫 “Too Easy, No Points” Option — in the game settings, turn this option on and players will not score points if everyone reaches the end. This is off by default, but a lot of Ultimate Chicken Horse players have asked for it so let’s see what you think!
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/560289f8-95fe-4f69-988d-58237ac0004e/2026-02-19+TooEasyOptions.png"]
You can see this in the lobby list if you’re looking at a match online, just like with Hardcode mode.
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/9fc4dfeb-be0f-4613-a5fa-47ab7733145f/2026-02-19+IconsLobbyEdit.png"]
💀 Hardcore Mode Is Now Its Own Game Mode — this was a lobby setting since December but people didn’t see it, so now we made it its own “game mode” which turns the setting on by default.
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/8186e0c5-c08a-4f14-9325-ec8c4a977ab9/2026-02-19+HardcoreMode.png"]
You can also see this in the lobby list, with the little hardcore icon. This icon updates when a host changes the game rules.
🧮 Solo Points Added — if you’re the only player who finishes, you now get solo points!

The umbrella was a little too good at letting players float across entire levels — so we’ve nerfed it! it now starts to fail after a given time, giving you less lift, then eventually closes by itself. Should be harder to jetpack or triple-jump into the sky and float across the whole level now.
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/e71fda78-a50a-40ea-b827-d88d21937ca7/2026-01-28+nerfed+umbrella.gif"]
Different trick types, including wheelie
What Hardcore Mode is
Clearer feedback when changing controls
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/2c394a11-335d-4daf-9cd9-080576e7c3c9/2026-02-19+HazardTutorial.png"]

notes.title: Small changes that make a big difference

items.text: Adjustable cursor speed
Windowed & borderless window modes added
No more slow smoothing in the level editor phase change (hold to build) and giving up — the circle in the UI fills up at a constant speed which causes less feeling of “but I held it long enough!”
Host player now gets a crown in lobbies (so everyone knows who can start the game)
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/02f184be-2c27-4adf-bcbf-cb2dfa51545f/HorseCrown.png"]
After uploading a custom level, you’ll see the share code immediately
[img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/1ff01066-7a5d-4174-b054-8ef2b99ab5a9/2026-02-19+LevelID.png"]

Missing UI bug, which we think causes the ghost bike issue where a player can control their fallen bike and never respawn — we made a lot of progress on this and it happens much less often, but still happens sometimes. We still have no idea why and can’t reliably reproduce the UI disappear bug, despite hours of QA… will continue trying.
Players no longer get stuck between cannons if they’re placed closely together
Achievement fixes (especially “Not That Way”)
Honey now sticks properly to moving objects (Cranes level objects, rotating terrain)
Game no longer crashes if a player joins as soon as a host leaves the lobby
Resetting in the tutorial doesn’t break the game anymore
Random level can no longer select locked levels
Fixed more issues with Simplified Chinese text
Ghost firework staying on-screen after placing and moving it in level editor mode
Tons of under-the-hood stability improvements
A bunch of UI and localization layout improvements
Refactored the block placement system to allow for more flexibility of how things can be placed

We’ve been working to address your feedback and this update is the first one which really shows how your feedback shapes the game. Keep letting us know what you think and we’re already underway with our next update, lots to do!
See you on the track 🏁🐑🦝
